d2017.Raw_Article: 2017 (a) Ta. kēḷ (kēṭp-, kēṭṭ-) to hear, listen, learn, ask, inquire, question, investigate, require, request, be informed of, obey; be heard (as a call), reach (as a sound); kēḷā to no purpose, vainly; kēḷvi, kēṭpu hearing, question, learning, sound, word, rumour, ear.
